conf.description: Facility SNMP APC/NMC event.txt tab-delimited event-log direct route: hand-built row split, header-metadata passthrough, event.code de-dup key, per recommendations.direct.cribl (no vendor pack/integration exists)

conf.comment: APC NMC event.txt fetched by an external scheduled FTP/SCP pull. ASSUMPTION (no sample row given): each event line is tab-delimited Date\tTime\tEvent\tEventCode with Date as YYYY-MM-DD; header-block lines (version, retrieval time, card Name/Contact/Location/IP) do not match this grammar and pass through unparsed. Assumes 'card Name'/'card IP'/'card Location' are already attached as per-row fields by the collector, since they are header-block-scoped, not per-row.

functions.description: Pipeline purpose and row-grammar / header-attachment assumptions
Split an assumed tab-delimited event row into Date/Time/Event/Event Code; header-block lines simply do not match and leave these fields undefined

Computed fields read via bracket access before rename: @timestamp constraint means the row's own Date/Time land on _time (never @timestamp) via Date.parse, not auto_timestamp, because they must be concatenated first; the three header-block fields have spaces in their vendor names ('card Name' etc.) so a path-based rename would fail HTTP 500 - read here with __e[] bracket access instead
Batch rename of the two clean-identifier staging fields our own regex produced

event.dataset (no hyphen, shared with the trap/poll routes' data stream) and cleanup of the two staging fields consumed into _time. The space-named 'card Name'/'card IP'/'card Location' originals are left in place as harmless duplicates - eval.remove rejects space-containing paths the same way it rejects hyphens
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
